records.text: Har'koa is a snow leopard goddess devoted to her children and concerned for the other gods. The Drakkari turn her magic against her offspring, and she seeks help freeing and restoring them. While bound by her subduers, she cannot discern the other gods' fates and asks allies to investigate Quetz'lun. She grieves fallen friends yet believes their spirits endure. She values those who aid the gods and fears for allies sent against the Prophet of Akali.
